title: OpenMMReasoner: Pushing the Frontiers for Multimodal Reasoning with an Open and General Recipe
authors_zh: Kaichen Zhang、Keming Wu、Zuhao Yang、Bo Li、Kairui Hu、Bin Wang、Ziwei Liu、Xingxuan Li、Lidong Bing
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理数据发布与SFT-to-RL配方
best_for_zh: 视觉推理冷启动、RLVR、混合奖励与开放发布研究者
one_line: Separates an open 874K multimodal SFT conversation mixture from roughly 73K released RL training prompts and unreleased 16-way online GSPO rollouts, with mixed rule, learned-judge, and format rewards.
公开约87.4万条多模态SFT对话与72,971条RL训练提示，训练时再在线采样16路回答并用规则/裁判正确性与格式奖励驱动GSPO，但rollout本身未发布。
why: It makes a two-stage multimodal reasoning recipe inspectable and shows why released prompts, generated trajectories, terminal rewards, and policy updates must remain distinct audit objects.
inclusion_reason: Exposes a large multimodal SFT mixture, a distinct RL prompt and reward-metadata release, two checkpoints, and code linking teacher distillation, mixed terminal rewards, and online GSPO, while leaving the rollout and decision lineage partially unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal reasoning post-training has at least four different data objects: supervised conversations used for a cold start, prompts used to initiate reinforcement learning, responses sampled online by the current policy, and the rewards or decisions applied to those responses. Calling all four "the dataset" hides which object is actually released and which feedback contract created it. OpenMMReasoner addresses the operational gap by presenting one SFT-to-RL recipe around Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and releasing data, checkpoints, and training code.

The official paper is arXiv:2511.16334v4, first submitted in 2025 and supported as CVPR 2026 by the official CVF supplemental record. The paper studies image-conditioned general reasoning, visual and textual mathematics, science, charts, puzzles, and transfer to text-only reasoning. It does not study video or audio, and its training experiments remain within the Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct family.

The public objects must be separated. OpenMMReasoner-SFT-874K is an approximately 874K-row conversation mixture with assistant reasoning traces. OpenMMReasoner-RL-74K is a prompt and reward-metadata package: its train rows carry prompts, images, ground truth, a reward style, token counts, and an average-reward field, but not the 16 current-policy responses generated during GSPO. The collection also includes a 1,724-row validation configuration, so the live release is about 73K training prompts plus validation rather than 74.7K training prompts.

For the atlas, the decision boundary is whether the release makes construction and feedback reusable enough to audit. OpenMMReasoner exposes more of the stack than a checkpoint-only report, but it does not expose complete SFT rejection lineage, online RL trajectories, judge transcripts, or an immutable paper-run manifest. Those absences are part of the data object, not minor documentation details.

多模态推理后训练至少涉及四种不同数据对象:用于冷启动的监督对话、用于启动强化学习的提示、当前策略在线采样的回答,以及作用于这些回答的奖励或决策。若把四者都称为"数据集",就会掩盖究竟公开了什么,以及每个对象由哪一种反馈契约产生。OpenMMReasoner 围绕 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 给出一条 SFT-to-RL 配方,并发布数据、检查点与训练代码,以处理这一操作性缺口。

官方论文为 arXiv:2511.16334v4,首次提交于 2025 年;CVPR 2026 状态由 CVF 官方补充材料记录支持。论文研究图像条件下的通用推理、视觉与文本数学、科学、图表、谜题,以及向纯文本推理的迁移。它没有研究视频或音频,训练实验也仍局限在 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 系列。

公开对象必须分开理解。OpenMMReasoner-SFT-874K 是约 87.4 万行的对话混合数据,包含 assistant 推理轨迹。OpenMMReasoner-RL-74K 则是提示与奖励元数据包:训练行带有 prompt、图像、ground truth、奖励类型、token 计数和平均奖励字段,却不包含 GSPO 期间由当前策略生成的 16 条回答。该 collection 还包含 1,724 行 validation 配置,因此实时发布更准确地说是约 7.3 万个训练提示加验证集,而不是 7.47 万个训练提示。

对 atlas 而言,关键判断是该发布是否让构造过程与反馈契约具有足够的可复用性和可审计性。OpenMMReasoner 比只发布检查点的报告开放了更多环节,但仍未公开完整 SFT 拒绝谱系、在线 RL 轨迹、裁判记录或不可变的论文运行清单。这些缺失本身就是数据对象边界,而不是次要文档问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a linked but non-uniform two-stage recipe. On the SFT side, the paper starts from about 103K public questions, selects Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct as the teacher, retains candidates after format and final-answer verification, scales answer diversity up to eight samples per question, and reports about 583K verified general-reasoning traces. Mixing MMR1 image-math and MiroMind-M1 text-math data produces the final 874K cold-start mixture.

The released SFT object has five configurations: OpenVLThinker-sft-iter3 (22.2K), WeMath (6.94K), llava_cot (554K), m1_sft (92K), and mmr1 (199K). Each row is essentially id plus messages; the messages contain an instruction, a multimodal or textual user request, and an assistant response using think and answer tags. The row does not carry the teacher revision, sampling index, validator decisions, rejected candidates, or upstream license lineage.

On the RL side, the paper sources questions from multimodal science, mathematics, charts, and puzzles, verifies extractable answers, and deduplicates questions by image and text similarity. The released train row is a task specification, not a completed trajectory: core fields are prompt, images, data_source, ability, reward_model.ground_truth, reward_model.style, tokens, and avg_reward, with additional source-specific columns. During training, the current policy then samples 16 new responses for a prompt and receives terminal rewards.

The feedback chain has three separate layers. First, the release supplies a ground-truth-oriented reward specification. Second, the code tries rule matching and math_verify, then optionally falls back to the default Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 judge. Third, answer accuracy is mixed with format compliance as 0.9 R_acc + 0.1 R_fmt. None of these layers is a direct label of local step validity.

该贡献是一条相互连接但对象并不相同的两阶段配方。SFT 阶段从约 10.3 万个公开问题出发,选择 Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct 作为教师,通过格式与最终答案验证保留候选,再把每题答案多样性扩展到最多 8 次采样,形成约 58.3 万条经验证的通用推理轨迹。随后混入 MMR1 图像数学数据与 MiroMind-M1 文本数学数据,得到最终 87.4 万条冷启动混合数据。

公开 SFT 对象有 5 个配置:OpenVLThinker-sft-iter3(2.22 万)、WeMath(0.694 万)、llava_cot(55.4 万)、m1_sft(9.2 万)和 mmr1(19.9 万)。每行基本只有 id 与 messages;消息包含一条指令、多模态或文本用户请求,以及使用 think/answer 标签的 assistant 回答。记录中没有教师版本、采样序号、验证器判决、被拒候选或上游许可谱系。

RL 阶段从多模态科学、数学、图表与谜题来源收集问题,验证可抽取答案,并按图像与文本相似度去重。公开训练行是任务规范,而不是已完成轨迹:核心字段包括 prompt、images、data_source、ability、reward_model.ground_truth、reward_model.style、tokens 和 avg_reward,另有各来源特有列。真正训练时,当前策略才会针对每个 prompt 在线采样 16 条新回答并接收终局奖励。

反馈链需要分成三层。第一层,发布数据提供面向 ground truth 的奖励规范。第二层,代码先尝试规则匹配与 math_verify,再可选回退到默认 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 裁判。第三层,把答案正确性与格式遵循组合为 0.9 R_acc + 0.1 R_fmt。这三层中的任何一层都不是局部步骤有效性的直接标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction can be audited as five stages.

  1. Source and teacher study. The SFT pipeline begins with approximately 103K question-answer pairs from LLaVA-CoT, OpenVLThinker, and WeMath2.0. Candidate teacher traces undergo format checking and final-answer verification. The paper reports that Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct performs best among the tested teachers and that the one-sample stage retains about 59K traces. The exact endpoint revision, generation seed, and item-level verification ledger are unknown.
  2. SFT scaling and mixing. The selected teacher produces up to eight verified answers per question, yielding about 583K general-reasoning traces. Experiments with length and difficulty filtering reduce the reported downstream average, so the final recipe keeps this general set without those filters. Adding MMR1 image-math and MiroMind-M1 text-math data yields 874K rows. LMMs-Engine trains Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with online packing, a 61,440-token packing length, AdamW, cosine scheduling, learning rate 5e-5, and 4,300 reported steps.
  3. RL prompt preparation. The paper names MMEureka, ViRL, TQA, We-Math, PuzzleVQA, AlgoPuzzleVQA, and ThinkLiteVL as source families. It extracts and verifies final answers, then removes similar questions using image and text embeddings. The public deduplication implementation performs cross-source nearest-neighbor removal and defaults to a 0.99 threshold, but the exact paper-run threshold and removed IDs are unknown.
  4. Online generation and reward. The final released example starts from OpenMMReasoner-ColdStart, samples 16 responses per prompt at temperature 1.0, caps prompts at 4,096 tokens and responses at 28,696 tokens, and trains with global batch size 128. Accuracy first uses answer extraction, multiple-choice or relaxed exact matching, and math_verify; if these fail and learned judging is enabled, the code queries a separately served judge. Format compliance contributes 0.1 and answer correctness 0.9. The 16 response texts, extracted answers, judge calls, and per-response rewards are transient training objects and are not in RL-74K.
  5. GSPO optimization and evaluation. verl and vLLM provide the online environment; the chosen launch uses GSPO, 1,232 paper-reported RL steps, constant learning-rate scheduling at 1e-6, weight decay 0.1, and an overlength strategy. The paper compares GSPO, GRPO, and DAPO and uses 16 rollouts in the selected configuration. Evaluation separately applies a rule-first, learned-judge-second answer procedure; its temperature and generation budget are not the RL sampling settings.

The repository is a runnable scaffold rather than an immutable experiment package. Paths and service addresses require editing, no GitHub release pins the paper state, and the live Hub schema does not exactly match the eight training files listed by the launch script. Reproduction therefore requires recording commit, dataset revisions, model revisions, judge endpoint, all environment variables, and generated rollout logs.

该构造过程可拆成 5 个可审计阶段。

  1. 来源与教师研究。 SFT 流程从 LLaVA-CoT、OpenVLThinker 和 WeMath2.0 的约 10.3 万个问答对开始。候选教师轨迹经过格式检查与最终答案验证。论文报告 Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct 在所测教师中最好,单次采样阶段保留约 5.9 万条轨迹;但精确 endpoint 版本、生成 seed 和逐条验证 ledger 均为 unknown。
  2. SFT 扩展与混合。 选定教师为每题生成最多 8 个经验证答案,得到约 58.3 万条通用推理轨迹。长度过滤和难度过滤在实验中都降低了所报告的下游平均结果,因此最终配方不对这批通用数据采用二者。再加入 MMR1 图像数学与 MiroMind-M1 文本数学数据,形成 87.4 万行。LMMs-Engine 对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 进行 online packing SFT,packing length 为 61,440 token,使用 AdamW、cosine scheduler、5e-5 学习率和论文报告的 4,300 个训练 step。
  3. RL prompt 准备。 论文列出的来源族包括 MMEureka、ViRL、TQA、We-Math、PuzzleVQA、AlgoPuzzleVQA 和 ThinkLiteVL。流程抽取并验证最终答案,再用图像与文本 embedding 去除相似问题。公开去重实现执行跨来源近邻移除,默认阈值为 0.99,但论文运行的精确阈值与被移除 ID 均为 unknown。
  4. 在线生成与奖励。 最终公开示例从 OpenMMReasoner-ColdStart 出发,在温度 1.0 下为每个 prompt 采样 16 条回答,prompt 上限为 4,096 token,回答上限为 28,696 token,全局 batch size 为 128。正确性先经过答案抽取、选择题或宽松精确匹配以及 math_verify;若这些检查失败且启用学习式裁判,代码才请求独立部署的 judge。格式遵循权重为 0.1,答案正确性权重为 0.9。16 条回答文本、抽取答案、裁判调用和逐回答奖励都是训练时临时对象,不在 RL-74K 中。
  5. GSPO 优化与评估。 verl 与 vLLM 提供在线环境;选定配方使用 GSPO、论文报告的 1,232 个 RL step、1e-6 恒定学习率、0.1 weight decay 和 overlength 策略。论文比较 GSPO、GRPO 与 DAPO,并在最终配置中使用 16 条 rollout。评估阶段另行采用先规则、后学习式裁判的答案流程;其温度和生成预算不能与 RL 采样设置混为一谈。

该仓库是可运行脚手架,而不是不可变实验包。路径与服务地址仍需编辑,没有 GitHub release 固定论文状态,实时 Hub schema 也没有与启动脚本列出的 8 个训练文件完全对应。因此,复现时必须记录 commit、数据集版本、模型版本、judge endpoint、全部环境变量以及生成的 rollout 日志。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The artifact evidence is concrete. The official collection links two 8B checkpoints, SFT-874K, RL-74K, the project page, and arXiv. The SFT Hub API exposes five train configurations totaling 874,357 rows: OpenVLThinker-sft-iter3 22,229, WeMath 6,944, llava_cot 553,806, m1_sft 91,953, and mmr1 199,425. Its schema verifies id and nested multimodal messages. The RL viewer exposes source-specific schemas around a common task interface and shows reward_model as a structure with ground_truth and style; checked first rows use style: rule.

The RL release boundary is also directly visible. Seven configurations have train splits: algopuzzle, mmk12, thinklite_vl_hard, tqa_train, virl39k, wemath_pro, and wemath_standard. Their API counts total 72,971 rows. The eighth configuration, validation, has a 1,724-row val split, includes extra_info, and lacks avg_reward; together these produce the collection's 74,695-row display total. No released field contains an online response, rollout ID, extracted answer, judge output, group reward, or policy-update reference.

The paper reports downstream evidence at three levels. Expanding verified SFT answer sampling from one to eight traces per source question raises the three-benchmark average from 50.5 to 55.2 (paper Table 3; supplement Table 2). Mixing both image- and text-math data then raises the same average from 55.2 to 56.3 (paper Table 5). For the selected cross-domain cold start, GSPO with 16 rollouts reaches a 54.3 average versus the 49.4 no-RL baseline and is reported as more stable than GRPO and DAPO (paper Table 7 and Figure 4). The final model is reported to improve 11.6% over Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct across nine multimodal benchmarks; on text-only evaluation, the baseline/cold-start/RL averages are 15.1/22.2/29.4 over AIME24, AIME25, and GPQA-Diamond (paper Table 8).

These results support the recipe as a training intervention under the authors' setup. They do not show that every SFT rationale is faithful, every avg_reward is reproducible, every ground truth is correct, or every upstream row is uncontaminated and license-compatible. The paper's qualitative traces and rollout word cloud are selected analyses, not validation of the released data at record level.

产物证据是具体可核验的。官方 collection 链接两个 8B 检查点、SFT-874K、RL-74K、项目页与 arXiv。SFT Hub API 显示 5 个 train 配置,合计 874,357 行:OpenVLThinker-sft-iter3 为 22,229 行、WeMath 为 6,944 行、llava_cot 为 553,806 行、m1_sft 为 91,953 行、mmr1 为 199,425 行;其 schema 可确认 id 与嵌套多模态 messages。RL viewer 则显示围绕共同任务接口的各来源 schema,其中 reward_model 是包含 ground_truth 与 style 的结构;所检查的首行均使用 style: rule。

RL 发布边界也可直接观察。7 个配置具有 train split:algopuzzle、mmk12、thinklite_vl_hard、tqa_train、virl39k、wemath_pro 与 wemath_standard,API 计数合计 72,971 行。第 8 个配置 validation 是 1,724 行 val split,包含 extra_info 且没有 avg_reward;二者合计形成 collection 页面所示的 74,695 行。公开字段中没有在线回答、rollout ID、抽取答案、judge 输出、组奖励或策略更新引用。

论文在 3 个层面报告下游证据。经验证 SFT 答案采样从每个来源问题 1 条扩展到 8 条后,3 个 benchmark 的平均值从 50.5 升至 55.2(论文 Table 3;补充材料 Table 2);再混入图像数学与文本数学数据后,同一平均值从 55.2 升至 56.3(论文 Table 5)。在选定跨域 cold-start 设置下,使用 16 条 rollout 的 GSPO 平均值为 54.3,无 RL baseline 为 49.4,且作者报告其比 GRPO 和 DAPO 更稳定(论文 Table 7 与 Figure 4)。最终模型相对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 在 9 个多模态 benchmark 上被报告提升 11.6%;纯文本评测中,baseline/cold-start/RL 在 AIME24、AIME25 与 GPQA-Diamond 上的平均值依次为 15.1/22.2/29.4(论文 Table 8)。

这些结果支持"该配方在作者设置下是一项有效训练干预"。它们不能证明每条 SFT rationale 都忠实、每个 avg_reward 都可复现、每个 ground truth 都正确,也不能证明所有上游记录均无污染且许可兼容。论文中的定性轨迹与 rollout 词云是选定分析,不是发布数据的逐记录验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior multimodal reasoning work often opens only a model, one training stage, or a narrow RL dataset. OpenMMReasoner's specific contribution is to connect a teacher-distilled cold start, answer-diversity scaling, cross-domain mixing, RL prompt curation, online group sampling, mixed terminal rewards, GSPO optimization, and two released checkpoints in one inspectable stack.

Two distinctions matter for data curation. First, the SFT experiments treat answer diversity as a scaling axis while showing that the tested length and difficulty filters can remove useful variety. This is a construction claim about candidate coverage, not evidence that unfiltered traces are universally high quality. Second, the RL study compares optimization and rollout designs while keeping the released prompt pool conceptually separate from responses sampled by the changing policy.

The open release is useful because it exposes both final training objects and substantial recipe code. At the same time, the strongest audit claim must remain narrower than the paper's language of full transparency: the release omits the SFT selection ledger, rejected teacher traces, the online rollout corpus, per-response reward/judge evidence, and a reconciled mapping between the paper's eight RL training sources and the live Hub configurations.

What is not new should stay explicit. The work does not introduce SFT, teacher distillation, RLVR, GSPO, rule-based answer checking, learned judging, or embedding deduplication individually. It also does not provide process-validity labels or prove that benchmark improvements identify a generally superior dataset. The direction signal is the integrated recipe and the unusually visible boundary between open artifacts and missing decision lineage.

既有多模态推理工作经常只开放模型、某一个训练阶段,或范围较窄的 RL 数据集。OpenMMReasoner 的具体贡献,是在一条可检查栈中连接教师蒸馏冷启动、答案多样性扩展、跨域混合、RL prompt 筛选、在线组采样、混合终局奖励、GSPO 优化和两个公开检查点。

对数据构造而言有两个重要区别。第一,SFT 实验把答案多样性作为扩展轴,同时显示所测长度与难度过滤可能删除有用多样性。这是一项关于候选覆盖的构造结论,不能证明"不做过滤的轨迹普遍高质量"。第二,RL 研究比较不同优化算法与 rollout 设计,同时在概念上把公开 prompt 池与变化中的策略在线生成的回答分开。

该开放发布的价值在于同时暴露最终训练对象和大量配方代码。但最强审计结论仍应比论文的"完全透明"表述更窄:发布中缺少 SFT 选择 ledger、被拒教师轨迹、在线 rollout 语料、逐回答奖励/裁判证据,以及论文 8 个 RL 训练来源与实时 Hub 配置之间已核对一致的映射。

还必须明确哪些并非新贡献。该工作没有单独提出 SFT、教师蒸馏、RLVR、GSPO、规则式答案检查、学习式裁判或 embedding 去重,也没有提供过程有效性标签,更不能由 benchmark 提升证明某个数据集普遍更优。其方向信号来自整合配方,以及开放产物与缺失决策谱系之间相对清晰的边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Release composition is ambiguous. The live RL collection totals about 74.7K only after adding a 1,724-row validation configuration to roughly 73K training rows. The paper and launch script refer to eight training files and include PuzzleVQA, but the checked collection exposes no PuzzleVQA train configuration. Exact paper-run-to-Hub mapping is unknown.
  • Rollouts are not released. GSPO samples 16 responses online, and the supplement says rollout logs were recorded for analysis. RL-74K contains prompts and metadata rather than those responses. Response text, rollout IDs, extracted answers, rule results, learned-judge calls, group statistics, rejected responses, and update-step joins are unavailable.
  • tokens and avg_reward are under-documented. Train schemas expose both fields, but the official dataset page does not identify the exact model revision, rollout count, decoding settings, seed, or run that produced them. Validation has tokens but no avg_reward. Their paper-run meaning is therefore unknown.
  • SFT validation is not fully operationalized. The paper describes rigorous step-by-step validation, while its method section explains format validation and final-answer checks using rules and a learned judge. Public SFT rows contain no step labels, validator traces, confidence, teacher revision, sampling index, or rejected alternatives.
  • Verifier errors propagate. Relaxed matching and parsers can mishandle equivalent forms; math_verify covers only supported expressions; the fallback judge can be sensitive to model version and evaluation instruction. The public material reports no calibration set, repeated-decision agreement, false-positive/false-negative analysis, or per-source error rate.
  • Terminal reward is not reasoning truth. The selected reward is 90% answer correctness and 10% format compliance. A correct final answer can follow flawed or visually ungrounded reasoning, and a valid path can be penalized by answer extraction or formatting. No process-validity supervision resolves this gap.
  • Selection changes the observed distribution. SFT keeps candidates passing verification and later chooses not to apply tested length/difficulty filters; RL verifies answers and removes similar questions. Without accepted/rejected counts and row IDs, source-specific survival rates, answer diversity, deduplication asymmetry, and failure coverage cannot be audited.
  • Contamination and rights remain partial. No released exact, near-duplicate, or semantic train-evaluation overlap ledger covers the combined SFT and RL sources. Code is Apache-2.0 and RL-74K is CC-BY-NC-4.0, but SFT-874K has no top-level license and record-level upstream text/image/teacher-output rights are unknown.
  • Reproduction is mutable. The repository had no formal release when checked. Launch files contain local paths and service endpoints, while model, data, code, and judge repositories can update independently. Hardware hours, random seeds, and checksums are unknown.
  • External validity is narrow. The experiments use one Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct family and primarily image tasks. Video, audio, richer temporal inputs, other architecture families, and the upper limit of further SFT/RL scaling are not established.

Benchmark gains are downstream model evidence. They do not certify rationale faithfulness, source cleanliness, reward calibration, license safety, or complete release quality.

• 发布组成存在歧义。 实时 RL collection 只有在把 1,724 行 validation 配置与约 7.3 万行训练记录相加后才达到约 7.47 万。论文与启动脚本提到 8 个训练文件并包含 PuzzleVQA,但所检查的 collection 没有公开 PuzzleVQA train 配置。论文运行到 Hub 的精确映射为 unknown。
  • rollout 未发布。 GSPO 在线采样 16 条回答,补充材料也称曾记录 rollout 日志用于分析;但 RL-74K 保存的是 prompt 与元数据,而非这些回答。回答文本、rollout ID、抽取答案、规则结果、学习式裁判调用、组统计、被拒回答和 update-step 连接均不可用。
  • tokens 与 avg_reward 文档不足。 训练 schema 暴露这两个字段,但官方数据页没有说明生成它们的精确模型版本、rollout 数、解码设置、seed 或运行。validation 有 tokens 却没有 avg_reward,因此这些字段在论文运行中的确切含义为 unknown。
  • SFT 验证尚未完全操作化。 论文称采用严格逐步验证,但方法部分具体说明的是格式验证,以及规则与学习式裁判执行的最终答案检查。公开 SFT 行没有步骤标签、验证轨迹、置信度、教师版本、采样序号或被拒替代。
  • 验证器错误会传播。 宽松匹配与 parser 可能错误处理等价形式,math_verify 只覆盖受支持表达式,回退裁判还会受模型版本和评估指令影响。公开材料没有给出校准集、重复判定一致率、假阳性/假阴性分析或逐来源错误率。
  • 终局奖励不等于推理真实。 选定奖励由 90% 答案正确性与 10% 格式遵循组成。正确最终答案可能来自错误或缺乏视觉依据的推理,有效路径也可能因答案抽取或格式问题受罚;没有过程有效性监督弥补这一缺口。
  • 选择会改变观测分布。 SFT 保留通过验证的候选,随后不采用所测长度/难度过滤;RL 验证答案并移除相似问题。缺少接受/拒绝计数和 row ID 时,无法审计逐来源存活率、答案多样性、去重不对称性和失败覆盖。
  • 去污染与权利信息不完整。 没有公开 ledger 对合并后的 SFT/RL 来源执行完整精确、近重复或语义级训练-评估重叠检查。代码为 Apache-2.0,RL-74K 为 CC-BY-NC-4.0,但 SFT-874K 没有顶层许可证,逐记录上游文本、图像与教师输出权利均为 unknown。
  • 复现对象持续变化。 检查时仓库没有正式 release。启动文件包含本地路径与服务 endpoint,而模型、数据、代码和裁判仓库可独立更新;硬件小时数、随机 seed 与 checksum 均为 unknown。
  • 外部有效性较窄。 实验只使用一个 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 系列,并主要围绕图像任务。视频、音频、更丰富时序输入、其他架构系列以及进一步扩大 SFT/RL 后的上限均未建立。

Benchmark 收益是下游模型证据,不能认证 rationale 忠实性、来源干净程度、奖励校准、许可安全或发布完整质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, OpenMMReasoner is most useful as a worked example of how one public project packages different stages of a reasoning-data lifecycle. It lets readers map source questions to teacher traces, retained SFT conversations, RL task specifications, online policy responses, terminal rewards, optimizer updates, and final checkpoints without collapsing those stages into one dataset.

The SFT release supports mixture analysis, formatting studies, alternative sampling or filtering experiments, and cold-start replication. The RL release supports prompt-pool analysis, reward-parser audits, alternative deduplication, curriculum design, and reconstruction of online GSPO. The checkpoints allow controlled comparisons between base, cold-start, and RL stages. Reusers should not treat avg_reward as a portable quality label until its generating policy, rollout count, sampling configuration, and seed are identified.

An auditable reconstruction should preserve three ledgers. The source ledger records upstream dataset and row ID, image provenance, license, split, and deduplication neighbors. The SFT decision ledger records teacher revision, rendered input, sampling index and seed, full candidate response, rule result, learned-judge request and result, retained/rejected status, and reason. The RL ledger records prompt revision, current-policy checkpoint, all 16 responses, extracted answers, accuracy and format components, judge fallback, group statistics, GSPO update, and any overlength or zero-variance filtering.

The recipe also enables controlled questions important to the track: whether answer diversity helps after matching compute, whether no-filter SFT remains robust under independent process checks, how image/text deduplication changes source balance, when learned-judge fallback disagrees with rules, and whether 8 versus 16 rollouts changes stability after matching sampled tokens. These studies require reconstructing the missing lineage rather than reading benchmark tables as data-quality certificates.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言,OpenMMReasoner 最适合作为一个完整案例,用来观察同一公开项目如何打包推理数据生命周期的不同阶段。读者可以把来源问题、教师轨迹、保留的 SFT 对话、RL 任务规范、在线策略回答、终局奖励、优化器更新与最终检查点逐层映射,而不把它们压缩成一个"数据集"。

SFT 发布可用于混合比例分析、格式研究、替代采样/过滤实验与冷启动复现。RL 发布可用于 prompt 池分析、奖励 parser 审计、替代去重、课程设计和在线 GSPO 重建。两个检查点则支持 base、cold-start 与 RL 阶段的受控比较。在确认生成策略、rollout 数、采样配置与 seed 前,复用者不应把 avg_reward 当作可迁移质量标签。

可审计重建至少应保留三份 ledger。来源 ledger 记录上游数据集与 row ID、图像来源、许可证、split 和去重近邻。SFT 决策 ledger 记录教师版本、渲染输入、采样序号与 seed、完整候选回答、规则结果、学习式裁判请求与结果、保留/拒绝状态及原因。RL ledger 记录 prompt 版本、当前策略 checkpoint、全部 16 条回答、抽取答案、正确性与格式分量、裁判回退、组统计、GSPO update,以及 overlength 或零方差过滤。

该配方还可支持本轨道关心的受控问题:匹配算力后答案多样性是否仍有收益;不做过滤的 SFT 在独立过程检查下是否稳健;图像/文本去重如何改变来源比例;学习式裁判何时与规则分歧;匹配采样 token 后 8 与 16 条 rollout 是否仍改变稳定性。这些研究必须重建缺失谱系,而不能把 benchmark 表格当作数据质量证书。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four objects separate: 874K SFT conversations, roughly 73K released RL training prompts, 1,724 released validation rows, and unreleased 16-way online rollout responses.
  • The SFT teacher is Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct; the default RL/evaluation fallback judge is the distinct Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507.
  • RL reward is terminal and mixed: rule or learned-judge answer correctness contributes 0.9 and format compliance contributes 0.1; no step-validity labels are released.
  • The live RL collection lacks the PuzzleVQA train configuration named by the launch recipe and reaches 74.7K only by including validation, so paper-run release mapping remains partial.
  • tokens and avg_reward are public fields, but their exact generating run is unknown; online responses, per-rollout scores, rejects, and judge transcripts are absent.
  • Treat benchmark gains as evidence about trained models under the reported recipe, not as proof of trace faithfulness, contamination safety, reward calibration, or license completeness.

• 区分四种对象:87.4 万条 SFT 对话、约 7.3 万个公开 RL 训练 prompt、1,724 条公开 validation 记录,以及未发布的 16 路在线 rollout 回答。
  • SFT 教师是 Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct;默认 RL/评估回退裁判则是不同的 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507。
  • RL 奖励是混合终局信号:规则或学习式裁判得到的答案正确性权重为 0.9,格式遵循权重为 0.1;没有发布步骤有效性标签。
  • 实时 RL collection 缺少启动配方点名的 PuzzleVQA train 配置,而且只有计入 validation 才达到约 7.47 万,因此论文运行与发布映射仍不完整。
  • tokens 与 avg_reward 是公开字段,但生成它们的精确运行仍为 unknown;在线回答、逐 rollout 分数、reject 和裁判记录均缺失。
  • Benchmark 收益只能作为所报告配方下的训练模型证据,不能证明轨迹忠实、去污染安全、奖励校准或许可完整。

value.html: The SFT release has five configurations derived from OpenVLThinker, WeMath, LLaVA-CoT, MiroMind-M1, and MMR1. The RL release has seven training configurations derived from AlgoPuzzleVQA, MMK12, ThinkLite-VL, TQA, ViRL, and two WeMath subsets, plus a separate validation configuration; record-level upstream rights and a complete source-to-row ledger are unknown.

SFT rows contain an id and a three-message multimodal conversation whose assistant text uses think and answer tags. RL training rows contain prompt messages, embedded images, a ground-truth-bearing reward_model object, tokens, and avg_reward plus source-specific metadata; they do not contain the online policy responses used for GSPO.

Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct generates the paper's repeatedly sampled general-reasoning SFT traces; some final SFT rows come from named upstream corpora. During RL, the current OpenMMReasoner policy generates fresh online responses. The exact teacher and policy checkpoint revisions are unknown.

Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is first trained by packed SFT with LMMs-Engine. The resulting OpenMMReasoner-ColdStart policy is then optimized online with verl, vLLM, and GSPO using 16 sampled responses per prompt in the released example.

For SFT distillation, the paper retains final answers that pass a rule-based validator and a learned judge, while the exact claimed step-by-step validation procedure is unknown. For RL, code first applies answer extraction, exact or multiple-choice matching, and math_verify; when enabled, the default Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 judge is a fallback. Accuracy is mixed with a format reward at weights 0.9 and 0.1.

An SFT candidate is retained after format and final-answer verification, but rejected-candidate logs are not released. An online RL response receives 0.9 times answer correctness plus 0.1 times format compliance; this scalar is a terminal training reward, not a step-validity label.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

Qwen3-VL-235B-Instruct is the selected SFT teacher; exact endpoint and immutable revision are unknown. The released reward setup separately names Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 as the default learned judge.

The selected teacher samples up to eight verified SFT traces per source question for the general-reasoning core. The current policy samples online responses during GSPO; these responses are not part of the released RL-74K rows.

Approximately 103K raw general questions -> teacher selection -> about 59K verified one-sample traces -> eight-way answer sampling -> about 583K verified general traces -> mix image and text mathematics -> 874K SFT rows -> cold-start model. Separately, source RL questions -> answer verification -> image/text deduplication -> roughly 73K currently released training prompts -> 16 online rollouts per prompt -> mixed terminal reward -> GSPO.

General SFT traces pass format and final-answer checks, after which the final recipe keeps the 583K verified general set without the tested length or difficulty filters and mixes math corpora. RL prompts undergo answer extraction and verification plus image/text embedding deduplication; the paper-run similarity threshold and complete removal ledger are unknown.

The paper reports a 4,096-token prompt cap, up to 28,696 new tokens per RL response, global batch size 128, 1,232 RL steps, and training until reward saturation. SFT uses 61,440-token online packing and 4,300 steps. Hardware hours, generation seeds, and total rollout tokens are unknown.
LMMs-Engine packed SFT followed by verl/vLLM online RL; the selected policy loss is GSPO with a DAPO-style reward manager and overlength handling in the released launch script.

The SFT Hub release exposes five train configurations: OpenVLThinker-sft-iter3 (22.2K), WeMath (6.94K), llava_cot (554K), m1_sft (92K), and mmr1 (199K), totaling about 874K rows. The RL Hub release exposes seven train configurations totaling about 73K rows plus a 1,724-row validation configuration. The paper and launch script describe an eight-source RL train mixture including PuzzleVQA, but the checked official collection has no PuzzleVQA train configuration.

Every SFT configuration has only a train split. Seven RL configurations have train splits; the eighth configuration is validation with a val split and a different schema. The mapping between paper-run files, current Hub configurations, and benchmark evaluation records is incomplete.

The paper reports answer verification and image/text similarity deduplication within the RL source mixture, and the repository releases an embedding-based cross-source deduplicator. Exact and semantic overlap checks against SFT sources and evaluation benchmarks, removed-row IDs, paper-run thresholds, and contamination rates are unknown.

items: SFT assistant traces are released, but the teacher revision, per-row teacher identity, generation seed, verification outcome, and rejected alternatives are not.
The paper calls the SFT process step-by-step validation, yet the operational description specifies final-answer rule and learned-judge checks; per-step labels or validation logs are not released.
RL-74K is prompt and reward-metadata data, not a corpus of the 16 online rollout responses used for policy updates.

The public RL collection combines about 73K train rows with 1,724 validation rows, while the paper and launch script refer to eight training files including PuzzleVQA; exact paper-run-to-release mapping is unresolved.

Public RL rows include tokens and, for train subsets, avg_reward, but the model revision, rollout count, sampling seed, and run that produced avg_reward are unknown; per-rollout responses and scores are absent.

Rule matching and math_verify can reject semantically valid answers or accept parser artifacts, while the learned fallback judge is model-, instruction-, and version-dependent and is not reported with calibration data.
Terminal answer correctness and format compliance do not establish that intermediate multimodal reasoning is faithful or visually grounded.
The final launch script samples 16 responses, but those online trajectories, judge calls, group rewards, discarded responses, and update-level logs are not released as a reusable dataset.
The release has no immutable GitHub release; code, datasets, and model repositories can change independently.
The study centers on Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct and images; video, audio, other base families, and the upper bound under further scaling remain untested by the paper.

value.html: The GitHub repository declares Apache-2.0 and RL-74K declares CC-BY-NC-4.0. The checked SFT-874K page has no top-level dataset license. Record-level upstream licenses, image rights, teacher-output terms, and a redistribution matrix are unknown.

Named SFT questions and existing traces -> Qwen3-VL teacher sampling -> format and final-answer verification -> 583K general traces -> MMR1 and MiroMind-M1 mixing -> SFT-874K -> OpenMMReasoner-ColdStart. Named RL question sources -> answer verification -> image/text deduplication -> released prompt/reward-metadata rows -> online current-policy rollouts -> rule or learned-judge fallback reward plus format reward -> GSPO -> OpenMMReasoner-RL.
